<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="PATCH" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/emails/smtp"}
#docs
Omit `password` to keep the stored one; send an empty string to clear it. Enabling SMTP requires host, port and a password.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `boolean` | no | Whether the business sends email through its own SMTP server. |
| `host` | `string` | no | The SMTP server's host name. |
| `port` | `integer` | no | The SMTP server's port. |
| `encryption` | `string` | no | The connection's encryption: `tls`, `starttls` or `none`. One of `tls`, `starttls`, `none`. |
| `username` | `string` | no | The SMTP user name. |
| `password` | `string` | no | The SMTP password. It is stored encrypted and never returned. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `smtp_settings`. One of `smtp_settings`. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | When false, this business sends through the deployment-wide MAILER_PROVIDER. |
| `host` | `string` | The SMTP server's host name. |
| `port` | `integer` | The SMTP server's port. |
| `encryption` | `string` | tls = implicit TLS (usually 465); starttls = required upgrade (usually 587); none = unencrypted, local sinks only. One of `tls`, `starttls`, `none`. |
| `username` | `string` | The SMTP user name. |
| `password_configured` | `boolean` | Whether a password is stored. The password itself is never returned. |
| `effective_transport` | `string` | What will actually carry this business’s mail, after the business setting and the deployment MAILER_PROVIDER are both resolved. One of `smtp`, `esp`, `console`, `unconfigured`. |
| `delivers` | `boolean` | Whether mail reaches a real relay. False for the console dev sink, which still marks messages sent. |
| `effective_from_address` | `string` | The From address the engine will actually use: this business’s email_config.fromAddress, or the deployment MAIL_FROM when it is blank. |
| `effective_from_name` | `string` | The From display name actually used: email_config.fromName, or the deployment MAIL_FROM_NAME. NOT the business name. |
| `from_source` | `string` | Whether the resolved identity came from this business or from the deployment default. One of `business`, `platform`. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Updated |
| `400` | Invalid SMTP settings |
| `404` | No such business |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X PATCH "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/emails/smtp" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "enabled": false,
    "host": "smtp.example.com"
  }'
```
